title: Coast Guard Rescues Two Near Main Pass
description: A Coast Guard Air Station New Orleans MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew rescues two boaters from a 13-foot aluminum flat boat taking on water near Quarantine Station in Main Pass on the Mississippi River, Feb. 10, 2016. The two boaters were safely taken to the Chevron Helicopter Pad in Venice where a friend picked them up. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station New Orleans.
